AuthorReference: Holds bibliographic authors where each row is one author for a reference (grain: one author per Refno) — keys/measures: Refno, Name, NameOrder.
CytoConvertedLog: Holds conversion log entries where each row is one logged event (grain: one log message) — keys/measures: RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Type, Message.
KaryBreak: Holds individual karyotype breakpoints where each row is one breakpoint occurrence (grain: one breakpoint) — keys/measures: RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, CloneNo, OrderNo, Breakpoint.
CytoConverted: Holds converted cytogenetic segment records where each row is one chromosome segment for a clone (grain: one clone–chromosome segment) — keys/measures: RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, End, Type, CellsPresent.
KaryBit: Holds karyotype bit tokens where each row is one bit of karyotype detail (grain: one bit) — keys/measures: RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, CloneNo, OrderNo, Bit.
Koder: Holds code definitions where each row is one code entry (grain: one Kod) — keys/measures: Kod, KodTyp, Aktiv, Intern, Benamning, Kortnamn, Notering, Inregdatum, GiltigFran, GiltigTill, Flagga1, Flagga2, Flagga3, Flagga4.
RecurrentNumData: Holds numeric recurrence summaries where each row is one chromosome–abnormality summary (grain: one Chromosome+Abnormality) — keys/measures: Chromosome, Abnormality, Morph, Topo, TotalCases, ChrOrder.
CytoBands_hg<N>: Holds cytoband coordinates for hg<N> where each row is one cytoband (grain: one chromosome–cytoband) — keys/measures: chromosome, cytoband_name, hg38_start, hg38_stop.
KaryClone: Holds clone-level karyotype metadata where each row is one clone within an investigation (grain: one clone: RefNo+CaseNo+InvNo+CloneNo) — keys/measures: RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, CloneNo, ChromoMin, ChromoMax, CloneShort, CloneLong, CloneLength, Sole.
Cytogen: Holds case-level cytogenetic metadata where each row is one case/record (grain: one RefNo+CaseNo) — keys/measures: RefNo, CaseNo, Sex, Age, Race, Series, Country, PrevTum, PrevMorph, PrevTopo, PrevTreat, HerDis, SpecHerDis, Morph, SpecMorph, Topo, Immunology, SpecObs, Origin, PatientID, PatientName, CaseOrder.
MolClinGene: Holds molecular clinical gene annotations where each row is one gene annotation for a molecular clinical record (grain: one MolClin+OrderNo) — keys/measures: MolClin, RefNo, InvNo, OrderNo, Prefix, Gene, Suffix.
RecurrentData: Holds recurrence summaries where each row is one chromosome–band abnormality summary (grain: one Chromosome+Arm+Band+Abnormality) — keys/measures: Chromosome, Arm, Band, Abnormality, Morph, Topo, TotalCases, Gene, ChrOrder, Type.
KaryAbnorm: Holds karyotype abnormalities at the clone/order level; one row per abnormality occurrence (grain: one abnormality) with keys RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, CloneNo, OrderNo and measure Abnormality.
MolClinBreak: Holds molecular-clinical breakpoint records; one row per reported breakpoint (grain: one breakpoint) with keys MolClin, RefNo, InvNo, OrderNo and measure Breakpoint.
Reference: Holds bibliographic reference metadata; one row per reference (grain: one reference) with keys RefNo and measures/fields TitleLength, TitleShort, TitleLong, Volume, Year, Journal, Text, Abbreviation, AuthorsLength, AuthorsShort, AuthorsLong, Flag, Pubmed.
MolClinAbnorm: Holds molecular-clinical abnormalities; one row per abnormality (grain: one abnormality) with keys MolClin, RefNo, InvNo, OrderNo and measure Abnormality.
CytogenInv: Holds cytogenetic investigation records; one row per investigation (grain: one investigation) with keys RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo and measures InvDate, Tissue, Clones, KaryLength, KaryShort, KaryLong, CaseOrder.
MolBiolClinAssoc: Holds associations between molecular/biological and clinical features; one row per MolClin–reference–investigation association (grain: one association) with keys MolClin, RefNo, InvNo and measures Morph, Topo, Immunology, GeneLength, GeneShort, GeneLong, KaryLength, KaryShort, KaryLong.
CytogenInvValid: Holds validation/results for cytogenetic investigations; one row per validation record (grain: one validation) with keys RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo and measures KaryLength, KaryShort, KaryLong, Message, Reason, CytoConvInput.
